title: A Million Trillion Pathways | Episode 2
synopsis: Set in a futuristic Tokyo, a group of hackers searches for their missing leader, Mako, only to discover that she has been taken hostage by a powerful enemy. As a mysterious swordsman enters the picture, the struggle to save her becomes part of a larger conflict involving ancient weapons, dangerous ambitions, and the fate of the city.
